title: Miniature
style: cinematic horror film still, buzzing fluorescent-lit storage unit corridors and a cramped city apartment at night, an eerily detailed handmade dollhouse, dust in the air, sickly green and warm tungsten tones, dramatic moody lighting, film grain, 35mm, highly detailed, subject clearly visible, no text, no watermark
caption:
Part 2. The dollhouse matches Gina's apartment exactly. Even last night's dishes. 🏚️

Original fiction. Part 3 tomorrow night.

#scarystories #horrorstory #creepy #storytime #fyp

scenes.narration: Last time: Gina won Lot 47 for forty dollars, and inside was a dollhouse of her own building, her window lit.
scenes.image: handmade dollhouse of a brick apartment building with one tiny window glowing

scenes.narration: In daylight, it's worse. The detail is impossible. Brushstrokes finer than an eyelash.
scenes.image: morning light through blinds falling across an intricately detailed dollhouse in a small apartment

scenes.narration: The front swings open on tiny hinges. Inside, her apartment. Her grey couch with the coffee stain. Her lamp. Her rug, with the corner that curls.
scenes.image: open dollhouse showing a tiny living room with a grey couch, a lamp and a curled rug, perfectly made

scenes.narration: Her kitchen. Dishes in the sink. Last night's dishes. And the mug she used this morning, sitting on the counter.
scenes.image: miniature dollhouse kitchen with tiny dirty dishes in the sink and a little mug on the counter

scenes.narration: She touches the tiny mug. It's warm. Like someone just set it down.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of a woman's fingertip touching a thimble-sized mug in a dollhouse kitchen

scenes.narration: Someone has been inside her home. Watching. Measuring. Building. For weeks.
scenes.image: dark apartment doorway at night, the hallway beyond in shadow, the dollhouse visible in the room

scenes.narration: She walks the real apartment, then the tiny one, comparing. Everything matches. Even the shoes she kicked off by the door. Even the crack in the bathroom mirror.
scenes.image: pair of worn sneakers kicked off by an apartment door, and an identical tiny pair in a dollhouse beside them

scenes.narration: Except one room. The tiny bedroom door is shut. Her real one is open.
scenes.image: miniature closed bedroom door inside a dollhouse hallway, lit by a desk lamp

scenes.narration: She pries it open with a fingernail. Inside, in the tiny bed, the covers are pulled back.
scenes.image: woman's fingernail easing open a tiny dollhouse door, revealing a miniature bed with blankets turned down

scenes.narration: And there's a dent in the tiny pillow. The shape of a head. Like someone just got up.
scenes.image: extreme close-up of a miniature pillow with a small fresh dent in it, soft lamp light
